matched_pairs.b_evidence_quote: We detect an object bounding box as a pair of keypoints, the top-left corner and the bottom-right corner, using a single convolution neural network.
we introduce CornerNet, a new one-stage approach to object detection that does away with anchor boxes.
CornerNet achieves a 42.2% AP on MS COCO, outperforming all existing one-stage detectors.
We first apply non-maximal suppression (NMS) by using a 3×3 max pooling layer on the corner heatmaps.
CornerNet achieves a 42.2% AP on MS COCO, outperforming all existing one-stage detectors.
A common component of state-of-the-art approaches is anchor boxes (Ren et al., 2015; Liu et al., 2016), which are boxes of various sizes and aspect ratios that serve as detection candidates.
Faster-RCNN does away low level proposal algorithms by introducing a region proposal network (RPN), which generates proposals from a set of pre-determined candidate boxes
